name: scholar-mcp
description: Scholarly-sources MCP server for papers, patents, books, and standards.

s2_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key
s2_api_key.description: Semantic Scholar API key. Optional but strongly recommended: unauthenticated requests are limited to ~1 req/s. Request one at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api#api-key-form.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: When true, write-tagged tools (PDF download and conversion cache writes) are hidden. Set false to enable them.

cache_dir.title: Cache directory
cache_dir.description: Directory for the SQLite cache database (cache.db) and downloaded PDFs (pdfs/, md/).

contact_email.title: Contact email
contact_email.description: Contact email for the OpenAlex polite pool (improves rate limits). Also enables Unpaywall lookups as a PDF fallback source.

docling_url.title: docling-serve URL
docling_url.description: Base URL of a running docling-serve instance for PDF conversion (e.g. http://localhost:5001). When unset, PDF conversion tools return an error.

vlm_api_url.title: VLM API URL
vlm_api_url.description: OpenAI-compatible VLM endpoint for formula and figure enrichment during PDF conversion.

vlm_api_key.title: VLM API key
vlm_api_key.description: API key for the VLM endpoint.

vlm_model.title: VLM model
vlm_model.description: Model name to use with the VLM endpoint.

epo_consumer_key.title: EPO OPS consumer key
epo_consumer_key.description: EPO Open Patent Services consumer key. Optional; patent tools are hidden when unset. Register at https://developers.epo.org/user/register.

epo_consumer_secret.title: EPO OPS consumer secret
epo_consumer_secret.description: EPO Open Patent Services consumer secret. Optional; patent tools are hidden when unset.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.
